title: Snippets
description: snippets.json (data folder root): a JSON array of reusable prompt texts, inserted by typing @name in a composer; global ones and every board's own live in this one file. Type Snippet in src/board/snippets.ts; written by Snippets.writeAll (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, atomic temp+rename) on create, update, remove and when a board is deleted (its snippets go). File order is the order they were made; the list is sorted by name only when read. A file that is not an array reads as empty. Unknown fields must be kept.

name.description: Without the @; at most 40 chars. Unique per scope.

text.description: Not only whitespace; at most 20000 chars.
